documents.title: Migraine and CGRP mechanism note
documents.text: Migraine research frequently connects CGRP signaling to disease mechanisms. Erenumab is represented in this demo as a drug targeting the CGRP-related pathway, while CGRP participates in the CGRP signaling pathway associated with migraine.

documents.title: Migraine clinical trial note
documents.text: The clinical trial node NCT02066415 is linked to erenumab and migraine in this demo graph, allowing traversal from a disease to an investigated drug through trial evidence.

documents.title: Breast cancer HER2 mechanism note
documents.text: Trastuzumab targets HER2 biology represented by ERBB2. ERBB2 participates in HER2 signaling, and HER2 signaling is associated with HER2-positive breast cancer.

documents.title: Type 2 diabetes metformin pathway note
documents.text: Metformin is connected to metabolic regulation in this demo graph. INS participates in insulin signaling, and insulin signaling is associated with type 2 diabetes mechanisms.
